last_assistant_message:
## Summary

Processed the Plaud transcript staging backlog at `~/Downloads/transcript-staging/`.

**PHI/policy fix (done first):** Found 4 medical/clinical transcripts still sitting in the main staging folder that should have been excluded per the existing `_medical_excluded/` convention (org policy: don't process PHI). Moved all 4 (plus their `_raw.json`/`_speakers.json` companions) into `_medical_excluded/`, removing them from the main folder. One (Tarlov Cysts SOAP note) had never been excluded at all — that gap is now closed.

**Dedup:** The staging folder had 121 transcript `.md` files but most were stale duplicates of meetings already ingested into the vault. Rather than trust title-matching (Plaud auto-titles vs. vault titles differ), I extracted the Plaud `file_id` from each `_raw.json` and cross-referenced it against the `file_id` frontmatter field already stored in existing vault notes — the skill's documented dedup key. That gave an exact match: **99 already-processed duplicates** (deleted from staging) and **17 genuinely new recordings**.

**Processed all 17 new recordings** into tagged Obsidian notes under `zzPlaud/{Client,Improving,YPO,Other}/`, each with proper frontmatter (`file_id`, tags, `meta/timeline`), Meeting Details/Attendees/Summary/Key Discussion Points/Action Items sections, and the full verbatim transcript preserved in a `<details>` block. Linked every new note from its date's daily note under `Calendar/2026/...` (created 6 daily notes that didn't exist yet, appended to 3 that did).

**Cleanup:** Staging folder is now empty except for the fetch script's reference file and the archive/excluded subfolders — reconciliation confirmed zero unprocessed transcripts remain.

Notable new notes: Moto/Chevron payments engagement (two linked meetings), Systemic Compliance SC IMS architecture session, Mash AI platform demo, Wendy's AI maturity review, Health and Safety Council proposal, and several YPO/personal entries.

Skill-run signal file updated at `systems/eval-harness/skill-runs/plaud-transcripts-latest.json` (status: success).
